issues.test_name: [It] [bc-serial] PTP e2e tests PTP Outage recovery OsClockSyncState goes FREERUN on BC upstream loss and recovers to LOCKED [Serial]
issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** PTP OsClockSyncState recovery regression in release-5.0 causes 4 failures; 4 tgm failures reflect missing WPC GM hardware.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_regression
**Overall Severity:** HIGH

## Root Causes (8 failures across 2 suites)

### 4/8 failures — OsClockSyncState/phc2sys state-transition regression in release-5.0 linuxptp-daemon
- **Suites:** bc+dualnicbc+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** After upstream link loss, ptp4l recovers (clock-class test passes) but OsClockSyncState never returns to LOCKED within 413s; phc2sys failover and TBC reboot-recovery assertions fail consistently across all affected topologies in the same run.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (last commit 9b766f3 is upstream-sync only)
- **Flake?** no
- **Fix:** Audit OsClockSyncState transition logic and phc2sys→LOCKED reporting path in the release-5.0 linuxptp-daemon image.

### 4/8 failures — WPC GM / tgm topology absent or undetected in lab
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** HYPOTHESIS
- **What:** All tgm-serial WPC GM tests errored while their bc-serial equivalents show near-zero skips, indicating the WPC T-GM node label or GNSS hardware was not present/recognized at runtime; no tgm XML or failure log was available to confirm further.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes
- **Fix:** Verify WPC GM node labels and GNSS signal state before the next run; add an explicit topology guard to skip rather than error when hardware is absent.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | OsClockSyncState FREERUN recovery (BC) | bc+dualnicbc… | OsClockSyncState regression | test_regression | HIGH | phc2sys→LOCKED reporting broken in release-5.0 | Fix OsClockSyncState state machine |
| 2 | OsClockSyncState FREERUN recovery (DualNICBC) | bc+dualnicbc… | OsClockSyncState regression | test_regression | HIGH | phc2sys→LOCKED reporting broken in release-5.0 | Fix OsClockSyncState state machine |
| 3 | DualNICBCHA phc2sys failover | bc+dualnicbc… | OsClockSyncState regression | test_regression | MEDIUM | phc2sys sync-source switch assertion fails in release-5.0 | Fix phc2sys failover reporting |
| 4 | TBC reboot discovery/sync | bc+dualnicbc… | OsClockSyncState regression | test_regression | MEDIUM | Post-reboot LOCKED confirmation fails, likely same regression | Fix sync-state reporting after reboot |
| 5 | PTP ClockSync nodeLabel match [tgm-serial] | tgm | WPC GM hardware absent | test_flake | LOW | tgm node label missing or hardware not detected | Add topology guard/skip |
| 6 | WPC GM GNSS signal loss holdover [tgm-serial] | tgm | WPC GM hardware absent | test_flake | LOW | WPC T-GM not present or GNSS signal unavailable | Add topology guard/skip |
| 7 | ts2phc termination FREERUN recovery [tgm-serial] | tgm | WPC GM hardware absent | test_flake | LOW | WPC T-GM not present or GNSS signal unavailable | Add topology guard/skip |
| 8 | T-GM Events GNSS reboot/recovery [tgm-serial] | tgm | WPC GM hardware absent | test_flake | LOW | WPC T-GM not present or GNSS signal unavailable | Add topology guard/skip |

**Suite Issue Class:** test_failure

++ script='set -xe
yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
yum group install "development-tools" -y
wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
go version

# set +x here to hide pass from log
set +xe

echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

# Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

# Used for 4.15 and older releases.
if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
  pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
  podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
fi

set -x

export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

# run latest release on upstream main branch
if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "Running on upstream main branch"
  git clone --single-branch --branch main PTP_REPO_URL
else
  git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION PTP_REPO_URL
fi
cd ptp-operator
# OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
# For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
  sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
  make docker-build
else
  # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
  if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
    DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
  else
    DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
  fi
  sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
  podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
fi
podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
cd ..

if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
  # If we a running a downstream run we are done
  exit 0
fi

# If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
git clone --single-branch --branch main DAEMON_REPO_URL
cd linuxptp-daemon
# Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
